Pa- tients are thus also given prophylaxis with an NSAID or colchicine from the start of urate-lowering treatment until at least a month after the plasma-urate has been reduced to an acceptable concentration; up to 6 months of prophylactic cover has been recommended. Once the hyperuricaemia is corrected, the patient contin- ues to receive therapy with allopurinol or uricosurics in- definitely. If an acute attack occurs during such mainte- nance therapy, this therapy should be continued to avoid fluctuations in urate concentration, and the acute attack treated in its own right.
